dedupe_keys.name: environmental statistics of north macedonia biennial 2007 2025 water abstraction public water supply wastewater discharges landfills municipal waste air soil and environmental protection spending

description: Environmental Statistics is a biennial bilingual publication of North Macedonia's State Statistical Office, prepared with the Ministry of Environment and Physical Planning, whose statistics page lists editions from 2007 to 2025 as PDF files. The 2025 edition read on 2026-09-28, the tenth, runs to 177 pages and covers water and air quality, soil, forestry and biodiversity, waste generation and management, material flows, and environmental protection investment and spending. Its infrastructure tables include municipal landfills and active landfills with their area by region, municipal waste quantities, the public water supply system by water source, discharges of treated and untreated wastewater from industry and mining by receiving water, total discharged wastewater, and wastewater disposal installations in dwellings from the 2021 census, mostly for 2024. Coverage is North Macedonia, nationally and by statistical region. Access is free; the publication asks users to cite the source and states no other licence. Caveats: tables sit in PDF, not machine-readable files, and editions differ in content. It supports water and waste capacity studies, such as comparing public water supply abstraction and wastewater treatment by region with EU directive targets. Related record: the ministry's annual waste indicators and reports.
